scope: Broaden current open-source DWG/DXF comparison across parser hardening, silent modeler omission, raw-carrier projection, and renderer/consumer limits; map actionable evidence to existing local plan owners and focused tests.

method.kind: Primary-source web research plus local source/test/plan inspection
localInspection: src/libdxfrw.cpp: dxfRW::writeMLineStyle finite-value preflight for startAngle, endAngle, and element offsets
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-07/S3.7, PAR-14, f.4b.1b, and existing modeler block/source-handle census requirements
method.evidenceRule: Peer reports/releases identify failure modes, not local defects or normative byte layouts. Autodesk DXF references support field roles only; ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout. Parser acceptance, opaque carrier retention, graph closure, semantic geometry, and consumer acceptance remain separate outcomes.

evidence.observed: The 2026-07-25 beta NEWS lists a non-finite MLINESTYLE angle writer hang, 3DSOLID SAT block-size arithmetic overflow, final SAT-block DXF export off-by-one, and multiple compressed-section/offset/count hardening fixes.
evidence.localObservation: The local MLINESTYLE DXF writer already rejects non-finite start/end angles before record publication. Existing focused MLINESTYLE tests cover color-representation refusal but no NaN/Infinity start/end angle control was found. The executable has an existing --mline-style-validation selector. Existing PAR-14/PAR-07/S3.7 owners already cover the broader bounds and carrier families.
evidence.disposition: No transferred defect. Add the missing small generated finite-value regression to the existing focused test owner; preserve the existing SAT bounds/final-chunk and section arithmetic owners.

evidence.observed: Open issue #1195 reports DWG-to-DXF omission of 3DSOLID/REGION from ACadSharp 3.4.9, including solid-only block definitions whose INSERTs then appear empty. Customer source DWGs are not attached; PR #1240 is open and not a released capability.
evidence.localObservation: The current adapter dispatches E3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY to the modeler-geometry writer. The plan already requires source-handle, owner/block path, INSERT reachability, writer disposition, carrier, and reopen inventories.
evidence.disposition: Retain the existing S8/PAR-07 gate and its solid-only/mixed-block controls. Do not classify the peer report as a local defect or use aggregate entity counts as proof of complete output.

evidence.observed: GDAL documents default skips for ACIS modeler entities and an AC1027+ optional raw ASM plus 12-real transform mode; it does not produce OGR solids. ezdxf documents multiple DXF versions and ASCII/binary I/O, but its drawing add-on does not render ACIS and projects 3D into the XY plane.
evidence.localObservation: These are distinct and useful projection/carrier routes, but neither documents a general semantic B-rep result for the comparison at issue.
evidence.disposition: Bind optional runs to exact version, operation, input AC code and options; exclude documented skips/XY projection from completeness denominators and keep raw carrier evidence separate from geometry semantics.

evidence.observed: The DXF table assigns real-valued start/end angles to groups 51 and 52, with 90-degree defaults; it does not define a special NaN/Infinity policy.
evidence.localObservation: Local finite checks are a safety policy. They should be regression-tested without introducing a new numeric range, normalization rule, or DWG-layout assertion.
evidence.disposition: Test NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity independently in both fields for ASCII and binary writer paths, asserting pre-publication rejection and a valid finite follow-up record/sentinel.
